data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 Jan 2017 (the 2016 closing balance) was GBP 225.947m. Using the gross claims development table, older underwriting years (2012-2015) show net adverse development overall, driven predominantly by a material increase in estimates for the 2015 underwriting year; the aggregate gross prior-year movement computed from the triangle is a strengthening of approximately GBP 12.76m (c.5.65% of opening gross reserves). No explicit single-sentence gross prior-year movement note was found; the figure above is derived from the gross claims development table.
raw_causal_phrases: It became apparent during 2016 that regulatory capital changes in China were not having the anticipated effect on reinsurance buying behaviour in the market and that cedants were not materially disenfranchised from purchasing cover offshore.
The following tables show the development of claims over a period of time on both a gross and net of reinsurance basis.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year movement (gross) was calculated from the gross claims development table on page 38 because no explicit labeled 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross-figure was found. exact_reserve_text is empty because the report did not contain a single verbatim sentence quantifying the gross prior year movement. Units in the triangle and notes are presented in GBP 000; conversions to millions were applied. Triangle-derived total gross reserves (sum of gross claims reserve row) is 394.872m versus balance sheet claims outstanding 396.750m (minor reconciling items may exist). Confidence for the computed PYD is 0.8 (calculated from triangle).
